A new dataset every week. A new chance to practice.

**TidyTuesday** is a weekly data project by the R4DS community — every Tuesday, a new dataset is released for the R community to explore, visualize, and learn from.

Here at R-Tide, we work through each dataset together.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

posts <- list.files("tidytuesday", pattern = "\\.qmd$", full.names = TRUE)
total_posts <- length(posts)
```

**`r total_posts`** TidyTuesday explorations published so far.
